meta.name: multi-program-manager
meta.description: Manage and compare multiple affiliate programs as a portfolio. Triggers on: "manage my affiliate programs", "compare my programs", "portfolio overview", "which program should I focus on", "diversify my affiliate income", "program switching", "affiliate portfolio", "program comparison", "revenue allocation", "which programs to drop", "add new programs", "affiliate program strategy".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理并比较多个联盟项目，优化收益策略
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果运营多个联盟赚钱项目，需要统一管理和优化
copy.tagline_en: Manage and compare multiple affiliate programs to optimize your earnings
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run multiple affiliate programs and need to manage and optimize them as a portfolio

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会将你的多个联盟营销计划视为投资组合进行管理和比较，生成包含概览、绩效、多元化策略和每周行动计划的仪表板，并给出每个计划是加大投入、维持、优化还是放弃的建议。
howto.when: 当你说出“manage my affiliate programs”“compare my programs”“portfolio overview”等关键词，或询问该专注于哪个计划、是否放弃某个计划时触发。

say.text: 帮我管理我的联盟营销计划组合。
say.note: Claude会创建组合仪表板并给出建议。

say.text: 比较我推广的几个联盟计划的收入表现。
say.note: Claude会对比各计划的EPC、收入占比等指标。

say.text: 我该多推广哪个联盟计划？
say.note: Claude根据绩效和风险分析推荐应加大投入的计划。

howto.what_en: Treats multiple affiliate programs as an investment portfolio: compares performance, assesses diversification, recommends whether to double down, maintain, optimize, or phase out each program, and outputs a dashboard with a weekly action plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says phrases like 'manage my affiliate programs', 'compare my programs', 'portfolio overview', or asks which program to focus on, whether to drop a program, or how to diversify income.

say_en.note: Creates a portfolio dashboard with recommendations.

say_en.text: Compare the revenue performance of my affiliate programs.
say_en.note: Calculates EPC, revenue share, and concentration risk.

say_en.text: Which affiliate program should I focus on?
say_en.note: Suggests the program with highest growth potential.
